home.metaTitle: analysisACE: Shariah screening, market history and household money for Bangladesh
home.subtitle: Clear Shariah screening and market history for DSE stocks, and every part of your household's money in one place: costs, holdings, Zakat, tax and plans. In Bangla and English.

hero.eyebrow: Made for investors and families in Bangladesh
hero.title: Invest with clarity. Manage money by your values.
hero.lead: See why a DSE stock passes or fails a Shariah screen, how it moved when rates rose or a crisis hit, and where your household stands on Zakat, tax and long-term plans. Every number shows where it came from.

questions.title: Answers to the questions you actually ask
questions.lead: analysisACE starts from the decisions people in Bangladesh make about their money, not from a list of charts.

halal.q: Is this stock Shariah compliant, and why?
halal.a: Every rule, the company's own figure, the limit and the report page it came from.

rates.q: What happened to stocks like mine when rates rose?
rates.a: A sensitivity score for each stock and sector, from five years of weekly data.

shock.q: How did the market behave in past crises?
shock.a: Moves after wars, energy shocks and policy changes, and how long recovery took.

zakat.q: How much Zakat do I owe this year?
zakat.a: A line-by-line calculation from your records, with a PDF in Bangla or English.

tax.q: What goes in my wealth statement?
tax.a: Assets, debts, income and tax already deducted, ready for your return.

fire.q: When could our savings cover our costs?
fire.a: A FIRE plan with what-ifs for a market fall, higher costs or higher inflation.

markets.title: Understand DSE stocks before you decide
markets.lead: Open methods, published rules and history you can check. analysisACE describes what happened; the decision stays yours.

shariah.title: Shariah screen with reasons
shariah.body: Two methods, AAOIFI-style and S&P-style, side by side. See which ratio decided a status and open the report behind it.

basket.title: Shariah list and basket
basket.body: Filter every screened company, and compare a basket of compliant stocks with the DSES and DSEX over one, three or five years.

rates.title: Rate sensitivity
rates.body: How far each stock and sector has typically moved when the 91-day T-bill yield rose one point, with the confidence of the estimate.

shocks.title: Shock playbook
shocks.body: How the market, sectors and single stocks moved after past wars, energy events and policy changes.

macro.title: Weekly macro note
macro.body: Yields, inflation, the taka, remittance, oil and the DSE each week, in plain Bangla and English, every figure sourced.

regime.title: Macro regime
regime.body: A monthly label from rates, inflation and oil, and how each sector did in past months like this one.

markets.watch: Watch any company and get a notice if its Shariah status changes.

money.title: Your whole household's money, organised
money.lead: Everything a Bangladeshi family owns and owes, from BO accounts to gold, land and sanchayapatra, with Zakat and tax worked out for you.

zakat.title: Zakat, line by line
zakat.body: Choose gold or silver nisab and the date. Every asset is counted at each member's share, with interest-bearing items flagged. Download a PDF statement in Bangla or English.

wealth.title: Everything you own
wealth.body: Bank, BO and fund accounts, sukuk and Islamic deposits, land, flats, gold and business stakes. Import your broker statement in one step.

check.title: Shariah check of your portfolio
check.body: Your compliant share by value, rate and shock exposure, and an estimate of dividends to purify.

tax.title: Tax statement
tax.body: Wealth statement, income by kind, tax deducted at source and rebate-eligible purchases for the tax year, as PDF or CSV.

plans.title: FIRE plan and goals
plans.body: See when savings could cover your costs, test what-ifs, and track goals for net worth or a target age.

costs.title: Costs and performance
costs.body: Monthly spending in today's taka, recurring bills added for you, and returns beside the DSE indices.

family.title: Built for families
family.body: Add members with their own roles and Zakat dates, split shared assets by owner, and keep parents' money in a separate household.

alerts.title: Gentle reminders
alerts.body: Notices for maturities, sukuk auctions, Zakat dates, drift from your target mix and goals reached.

steps.title: Up and running in three steps

one.title: Create your account
one.body: Sign up in a minute and choose Bangla or English.

two.title: Add your household
two.body: Record accounts, holdings, gold and land, or import a broker CSV.

three.title: See the full picture
three.body: Net worth, Shariah share, Zakat due and your plans, kept up to date.

trust.title: Built on trust, not tips
trust.lead: Money decisions deserve evidence you can check. These principles are part of how analysisACE is built.

traceable.title: Every number is traceable
traceable.body: Each figure shows its source and the time it was worked out.

rules.title: Rules are published
rules.body: Screening and Zakat rules are versioned, shown on every result and sent to a Shariah advisor for approval.

advice.title: History, never tips
advice.body: We describe how markets moved in the past. We never tell you to buy, sell or hold.

privacy.title: Your data, your control
privacy.body: Consent for every optional use, encrypted account numbers and documents, export or delete at any time.

local.title: Made for Bangladesh
local.body: DSE trading days, lakh and crore, Bangla digits, sanchayapatra, Mudaraba deposits and the July-to-June tax year.

own.title: Our own screen
own.body: analysisACE runs its own screening from company reports. It never republishes the DSE's licensed constituent list.

advice.a: No. analysisACE shows historical analysis for education. It never recommends buying, selling or holding anything, and the decision is always yours.

method.q: Which Shariah method do you use?
method.a: Two: an AAOIFI-style and an S&P-style method, shown side by side. The thresholds are published and versioned, and they stay provisional until a Shariah advisor approves them.

data.q: Where does the data come from?
data.a: Prices and indices from the stock exchange, rates and macro figures from Bangladesh Bank and other public sources, and company figures from annual and quarterly reports. Every figure names its source. While analysisACE is in development, market pages run on clearly labelled demo data.

privacy.a: Yes. Only members of your household can see it. Account numbers and documents are encrypted, optional uses need your consent, and you can export or delete your data at any time.

language.q: Can I use it in Bangla?
language.a: Yes. Every page, notice and PDF statement is available in Bangla and English, with Bangla digits.

final.title: Start seeing your money clearly
final.lead: Create an account, add your household, and see your Shariah share, Zakat and plans in one place.

data.title: Data
data.intro: Failed quality checks wait here. Bad rows are not stored until the issue is handled.
data.open: {n, plural, =0 {Nothing open} one {# open} other {# open}}
data.metalIntro: Enter the price a gram for the day (Q9: manual entry). A price far from the previous day's is refused.
data.csvIntro: Columns: code, date (YYYY-MM-DD), value. A file with any bad row is refused whole.
data.actionsIntro: Bonus, rights and splits rewrite the stock's adjusted prices at once.
data.ratioHint: Bonus 0.10 for 10%; split 2 for 1:2; rights shares per share held.
data.amountHint: Rights issue price, or cash dividend a share.
data.analyticsIntro: Screen, scores, event metrics, basket and regime run every night. Run them now after loading data.

shariah.title: Shariah screen administration
shariah.intro: Figures are screened only after a reviewer has checked them against the report. Overrides need a reason and are audited.
shariah.pending: {n, plural, one {# period to review} other {# periods to review}}
shariah.overrideIntro: Sets the shown status by board decision. Choose "No override" to go back to the screen's result.
shariah.note: Note shown on the company page
shariah.financialsIntro: Enter figures from the report in taka. Leave a figure empty when the report does not state it. Saved figures wait for review.

events.title: Shock events
events.intro: Published events appear in the shock playbook. Publishing computes the event's metrics and alerts users who asked for it.
events.slugHint: Lower case letters, digits and dashes, for example lng-fire-2026.

notes.title: Weekly macro notes
notes.intro: A draft is written every week from stored data. Edit the text, then publish each language.
notes.bodyHint: Lines starting with "## " become headings and "- " become list items.

audit.title: Audit log and jobs
audit.intro: Every admin action, override and access change. Entries name user ids, never emails.

bankFlags.title: Bank notices
bankFlags.intro: A notice appears beside a household's deposits at that bank. Keep it factual and give a source; it must not tell anyone what to do.
bankFlags.bankHint: Exactly as the bank appears in product and holding records.
bankFlags.deleteBody: The notice will no longer appear beside deposits at this bank.
